name: Managed IT + HIPAA security compliance for independent dental & vet practices — Chicago North Side
summary: Flat monthly managed IT (RMM, patching, EDR/MDR, email/DNS security, backup, network, imaging/PM-software support, same-day on-site within ~5 miles) plus an annual HIPAA Security Rule risk analysis and policies for independent DENTAL practices (HIPAA covered entities) and a cyber-insurance-readiness/PCI documentation layer for companion-animal VET practices (not HIPAA covered entities), 5-15 workstations, Chicago North Side (fallback: central DuPage). Founder is the first technician. Technician labor is capacity-triggered staff, so gross margin covers only per-practice tool and storage costs. Stage E refresh 2026-11-28.
evidence_notes: Published dental-MSP prices (re-verified 2026-11-28): Siotek $399/mo flat (~10 workstations, 4 on-site visits/yr) EXCLUDES Huntress EDR and Proofpoint email security (add-ons) and waives onboarding fees [B, E-WS04014-S004]; Darkhorse Silver $28.13/WS, Gold $49.93/WS ($422/$749 at 15 WS; $281/$499 at 10 WS), both incl. EDR/MDR, email security and 'HIPAA compliance'; no Chicago service area listed [B, E-WS04014-S005]. Chicago directory range $500-2,000/mo [D, DD-S019].

Correction (Stage E): veterinary practices are not HIPAA covered entities - HIPAA 'health care' relates to the health of an 'individual' (a person) [A, E-WS04014-S003]. The HIPAA compliance layer and the stand-alone HIPAA risk analysis are dental (and human-medical) products; vets get a cyber-insurance-readiness / PCI / client-data documentation layer instead. Blended ARPC lowered from $700 to $690 (75% dental at $700, 25% vet at ~$660).

Correction (Stage E): per-practice security stack re-priced with managed EDR at $7-12/endpoint and email security $5-10/mailbox (retail, vendor guide) [D, E-WS04014-S006]; MSP cost assumed at the low end -> ~$146/practice/month tools -> base recurring gross margin 0.79 (was 0.80).
Correction (Stage E): onboarding fee lowered to $1,000 base (was $1,500) because the main remote rival includes onboarding free and scopes remediation separately [B, E-WS04014-S004].

Insurance re-based on Insureon June-2026 medians for IT consultants (<5 employees): tech E&O $75/mo ($1M/$1M), cyber $128/mo, GL $31/mo [D, E-WS04014-S010]; an MSP with admin access to healthcare networks is riskier, so base $550/mo (~2.3x the $234 median sum), conservative $900, optimistic $400 (E). Was $700 base.

Chicago Personal Property Lease Transaction Tax on nonpossessory computer leases (cloud software) rose from 11% to 15% on 2026-01-01 [C, E-WS04014-S011]; applied to the RMM/PSA line in conservative/base (founder assumed Chicago-based). Whether bundled managed-service fees to Chicago clients carry PPLTT is UNCONFIRMED (tax counsel).

Tool costs: Syncro RMM/PSA $129-179 per technician/month, unlimited endpoints, AI features free until Jan 2027 then usage-based [B, DD-S017]; Backblaze B2 $6.95/TB-month [B, DD-S018]; Backblaze offers a BAA only to customers who are Covered Entities [B, E-WS04014-S013] -> practice-owned B2 accounts or a BAA-signing MSP backup vendor.
Technician cost: Illinois computer user support specialist median $59,860 (Chicago $60,730) [C, C6-S026], loaded x1.3 = ~$78k. One technician per ~28 practices (~300 endpoints) is an assumption (E).

Client loss: Illinois DSO affiliation +0.4 pts/yr (12.7% -> 13.9%, 2022-25) and dental establishment decline ~0.7%/yr [C, C6-S001..S004]; base churn 1%/month includes practice sales and switching (E).

Demand drivers: HIPAA Security Rule NPRM (Jan 2025) is still only proposed - Federal Register shows no final rule on 2026-11-28 [A, E-WS04014-S001]; the latest Unified Agenda moved it from 'Final Rule Stage' (target 05/2026) to 'Long-Term Actions' with final action 07/2027 [A, E-WS04014-S002]. OCR's Risk Analysis Initiative reached its 14th enforcement action by June 2026, incl. a $103k settlement with a small Illinois provider (1,980 patients) [C, E-WS04014-S008, S009]. Cyber-insurance MFA supplements (Travelers CYB-14306) require MFA for email, remote access and all admin access incl. third-party service providers, signed with the person in charge of IT security [B, E-WS04014-S007].

Long-term drivers: EV multiple applied to operating profit before owner pay (SDE-like). Sub-$1M-revenue MSPs with >=70% recurring revenue traded at ~5.4x SDE median (IQR 4.8-6.5x); <50% recurring ~3.4x [D, E-WS04014-S015]; smallest MSPs 3-4x EBITDA [C/D, E-WS04014-S014]. Base 3.5x, conservative 2.5x, optimistic 4.5x.
Funnel conversion rates and lead volumes are E. Standardized: founder draw $4,000/month from month 13, tax 30%, start capital = smallest amount keeping base cash >= 0.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: No licence; entity, cyber/E&O insurance, tool accounts, BAA template.
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: 1-3 months, often triggered by outage, new office, practice sale (Stage A/C).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified conversations with owner/office manager per month (walk-ins within the radius, equipment-dealer and broker referrals, study clubs) while founder also does technical work.
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Free network + HIPAA gap assessment -> written proposal.
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Newcomer vs incumbent IT provider; switching costs moderate (C6-S007 12-month terms).
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Peer/study-club referrals common in dentistry (Stage C, E).
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: IL DSO drift ~0.4 pts/yr + establishment decline ~0.7%/yr (C6-S001..S004) + switching (E).
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Remote rivals all-in for 10 WS: Siotek $399 + EDR/email add-ons (~$540-600) [B, E-WS04014-S004]; Darkhorse Gold $499 at 10 WS [B, E-WS04014-S005]; local $500-2,000 [D, DD-S019]. Base = dental 10 WS x $60 + $100 HIPAA layer ($700, 75% of mix) blended with vet ~$660 (25%, no HIPAA layer). Conservative = parity with remote all-in; optimistic = ~45% premium for on-site SLA.
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Onboarding/remediation (firewall, backup target, documentation, first risk analysis). Siotek waives onboarding and scopes remediation separately [B, E-WS04014-S004], so base lowered from $1,500 to $1,000.
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Per-practice tools ~$146/mo: managed EDR 11 x $7, email security 8 x $3, DNS filter 11 x $1.50, B2 backup 2 TB x $6.95, compliance portal $15 (retail ranges D, E-WS04014-S006; B2 B, DD-S018; MSP cost E). Same tool cost on $540 = 0.73; volume pricing on $860 = 0.84.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Website, local search, dental/vet society sponsorships.
drivers.dso_days__source: Billed monthly in advance on autopay (Stage A); negative = prepaid.
drivers.founder_draw_per_month__source: Standardized cross-finalist convention ($4k/mo living stipend from month 13).
drivers.lt_growth_y6_pct__source: Base model adds ~12-14 net practices/yr on ~57 at end of year 5 (~20%/yr customer growth) but each technician hire steps costs; 10% op growth in year 6 is below customer growth. Conservative 3% reflects IL dental establishment decline (-0.7%/yr) and DSO drift (+0.4 pts/yr) [C, C6-S001..S004].
drivers.lt_growth_decay__source: Local route density saturates; a second radius (DuPage) is a new unit. Conservative decays fast.
drivers.incremental_roic_pct__source: Growth capital = ~6 months of an under-utilised technician (~$39k) + hire capex $3k per ~28-practice unit that adds ~$40-50k operating profit at maturity (model staff/ARPC drivers) -> ~1.0x pre-tax; conservative assumes slower fill.
drivers.maint_capex_pct_op__source: Laptops, bench spares, test imaging workstation, vehicle share; client hardware is billed to clients (Siotek practice, E-WS04014-S004).
drivers.reserve_months__source: Two months of cash operating costs; three in conservative because a client ransomware incident or a DSO sale of 2-3 clients can hit in one month.
drivers.owner_comp_growth_pct__source: Engine default; stipend grows with inflation.
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Applied to op before owner pay (SDE-like). Sub-$1M MSPs: >=70% MRR ~5.4x SDE median, <50% MRR ~3.4x (BizBuySell/Host Broker via CT Acquisitions) [D, E-WS04014-S015]; smallest MSPs 3-4x EBITDA [C/D, E-WS04014-S014]. Dental-concentrated, founder-dependent book discounted to 3.5x.
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Standardized: smallest amount (rounded up to $500) keeping base-case cash >= 0; base peak funding $42,408 with the $4k/mo draw from month 13.
